name: forkpath
description: Change one moment in history and watch the consequences branch out. An AI-powered alternate-history mapper with odds at every fork.
author: Srilal Siriwardhane

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
